title: hogPack
description: pig pack with many pigs for bedwars. Bacon-sword, pig-axe, Wool-Hog and many pigs
body:
# 🐷 mega $win pack [Only for Bedwars]

The ultimate PvP resource pack meticulously optimized for **Bedwars** dominance on servers like DexLand and MineBlaze! No useless textures—only competitive advantages, clean visuals, and top-tier peak post-irony style by **mr.$win**.

## 🚀 Key Bedwars Features:
* **Custom Bedwars Arsenal:** Optimized PvP sword lengths for maximum screen visibility and clean field of view during sweat fights.
* **Bed-Hog Tanks:** 3D Custom Newspaper Hog-Tanks replace boring beds (Requires EMF / OptiFine). Protect your tank at all costs!
* **Isolated PvP Audio:** Clean `sounds.json` config with fixed hit registries. Custom pig-hurt and crit soundscapes to control your attack pacing.
* **Ambient Clean Mute:** Total mute toggle for Warden and noisy ambient mobs to let you hear enemy footsteps on wool blocks instantly.

## 🛠️ Required Dependencies:
* **Entity Model Features (EMF)** — Required for 3D Hog-Tanks bed models.

*Developed by mr.$win. Licensed under ARR.*
